title: Loc files
wikitext:
Loc files (.loc) are used in teamplay messages to report your position on a map. 

'''Get loc files: https://maps.quakeworld.nu/locs/'''


== FAQ ==
===  How to I install a loc file? === 
After downloading, you need to place it in /qw/locs folder.

=== Do I need to create a loc file?  === 
No, you download from the site.
=== Where can I download loc files? === 
https://maps.quakeworld.nu/locs/
